program.section_heading: Industrial PLC Technician, Associate in Science Degree
outcomes: Students will gain the basic knowledge required to take the CET (Certified Electronics Technician) exam.
Students will be able to work safely in accordance with NFPA 70E.
Students will acquire the skills necessary to connect to a PLC, diagnose system problems, backup a program, and restore a program to a controller.
Students will gain proficiency in reading and creating schematics, wiring diagrams, and ladder logic diagrams for advanced control systems.
Students will acquire hands-on skills working with HMIs, SCADA, and industrial communication protocols.
